title: terradish: Fast Gradient-Based Optimization of Resistance Surfaces
description: An R package for maximum likelihood estimation of parameterized conductance (resistance) surfaces in landscape genetics, via Newton and quasi-Newton methods. Supports terra-native workflows, multiple measurement models, spline and scale-aware conductance estimation, cross-validation across conductance models, hierarchical (covariate-plus-smooth-field) surfaces, and directional (non-reversible) conductance.
